data.name: FunCat Electric Catamaran Lounge Chair
data.headline: 1 Hour • Ages 18+
data.description: Our funcats are a super relaxing way to hang out and enjoy the sunshine and the water. It’s been dubbed a ‘floating lounge chair’. These electric powered catamarans include a Bimini for shade and cup holders for your favorite drinks.
data.highlights:
-Life vests included
-All vessels are required to stay within the bay

meeting_point.address: 1404 W. Vacation Way San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_to_bring:
Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching ID
Beverages and food if desired
what_to_bring_items: Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching ID
data.cancellation_notes:
#24 hour cancellation policy.
###All Cancellations or Rescheduling must be completed no less than 24 hours before the start of the reservation. If you need to reschedule or cancel please click on the Change booking or Cancel booking link in this email.
#Please Note
##- Sailing Lessons have a 48 hour cancellation policy.

data.booking_notes: #We look forward to you renting from us!
data.check_in_details:
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your reservation time.
- Please make sure to open your confirmation email or text and fill out the waiver(s) prior to arrival at the location
- All Equipment must depart and return from the rental location
data.pricing:
As low as $63.60 with our weekday early bird special!
Please select a date and time to view rates, rental durations and availability.
data.special_requirements:
- We recommend wearing the provided life jackets regardless of your swimming abilities 
- Passengers under 13 years old must wear a lifejacket at all times
data.disclaimers:
Late arrivals could cut into your rental time.
Group Reservations larger than 12  people or 10 rental items require a 20% gratuity added into the reservation.
